stem: Which shift-summary statement best communicates a production KPI concern to a supervisor?
choices: Verified completion rate fell below the recent comparable range in Zones 2 and 3; data quality was checked, affected scope is documented, and the leading process differences requiring follow-up are listed
The KPI proves the process design is wrong
rationale: A supervisor-ready metric handoff states the verified signal, scope, data-quality status, relevant context, and next follow-up without unsupported blame or causal certainty.
